mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS token_id, r.session_id, r.status, r.rotated_at, r.expires_at, s.absolute_expires_at FROM account_refresh_token r JOIN account_auth_session s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE r.token_hash = #{refreshHash} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE account_refresh_token SET status = 'ROTATED', rotated_at = #{rotatedAt} WHERE id = #{tokenId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE account_refresh_token SET status = 'REVOKED' WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE account_refresh_token r JOIN account_auth_session s ON s.id = r.session_id SET r.status = 'REVOKED' WHERE s.account_id = #{accountId} AND s.id != #{currentSessionId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE'
